tasks.short: Monitor actual batch, continuous or hybrid biofuels production.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual batch context, process trends and approved operating limits
inputs: actual current batch/stream identity
actual historian readings and approved operating limits
outputs: checked current process context and trends

steps.what: Monitor actual biofuels processes and investigate abnormal readings and physical conditions
inputs: checked current process context and trends
actual field observations and instrument status
outputs: actual observed process conditions and chosen follow-up

steps.what: Capture and check actual process observations and follow-up in required operations log
inputs: actual observed process conditions and chosen follow-up
outputs: checked final actual process observation entry

steps.what: Commit checked final process observation entry
inputs: checked final actual process observation entry

tasks.design: Configure native batch/stream views and approved-limit links in {OPS_SYSTEM} with references in {DOCS}. Retain actual surveillance, field checks and abnormal-condition judgement, then capture/check and separately save required observations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Monitoring can require repeated navigation across process views and batch context.
tasks.enabler_now: Native historian views can group existing readings and limits.
tasks.still_hard: Instrument error and real process deviation must be distinguished using actual conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises a condition requiring investigation rather than trusting an apparently normal trend.
tasks.altitude: Less process-view navigation; operational judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: historian views can group existing process readings and approved limits; this does not replace physical checks or process judgement.

assumptions: Existing instruments/historian produce batch or stream identity, tag, measured value, units, timestamp and quality status; actual procedure owners supply approved limits. S1 checks freshness and correct mapping; missing or bad-quality signals require manual verification.

S2 retains all actual surveillance and new field observation; s3 retains new observation capture and full checking. This is not automated control. Any actual setpoint action or escalation must be separately checked against its final action/content and gated; no avoided action/send time claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Existing displays/alarm runtime earn zero saving. Native views first. Actual observation record only if required; shared recording under 17828 counted once. Save retains one percent using existing final checking.
unknowns: Which view navigation repeats beyond the existing control display?
research_questions: Can native views reduce navigation after full process and data-quality checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual batch/tag mappings and approved-limit links.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual observation and exact operations-log destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 view navigation = 10; minus 0.5 upkeep = 9.5. Half eligible gives 5 minus 0.5 = 4.5. Actual monitoring, primary capture/check and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor and record biofuels processing data.

steps.what: Identify actual production interval and capture required noninstrumented processing observations
inputs: actual batch/stream and recording requirements
actual field observations
outputs: actual interval identifiers and newly captured field observations

steps.what: Transfer existing historian processing data into actual interval record draft
inputs: actual interval identifiers and newly captured field observations
existing historian values, units, timestamps and quality flags
outputs: source-linked instrument data draft for actual interval

steps.what: Monitor actual processing data and investigate gaps, deviations and implausible measurements
inputs: source-linked instrument data draft for actual interval
actual interval identifiers and newly captured field observations
outputs: actual checked measurements, explanations and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Complete and check final processing record against actual readings and observations
inputs: actual checked measurements, explanations and unresolved exceptions
actual interval identifiers and newly captured field observations
outputs: checked final processing record and actual interval destination

steps.what: Commit checked final biofuels processing record
inputs: checked final processing record and actual interval destination

tasks.design: Use native historian-to-log fields in {OPS_SYSTEM} before adding any integration. Transfer only existing measured values; the technician captures noninstrumented observations, monitors actual data, resolves exceptions and checks the final record before its separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Already measured instrument data may be manually rekeyed into production logs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native historian/log mappings can remove repeated transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement validity and actual unexplained process conditions require investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The technician spots readings that are numerically valid but inconsistent with actual production.
tasks.altitude: Remove repeated instrument transcription; retain actual monitoring.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: historian-to-log field mappings can transfer existing process readings without inferring physical observations or approving their validity.

assumptions: Actual instruments/historian produce batch/stream identifier, tag, value, units, timestamp and quality status. Explicit interval/tag mapping excludes stale, missing and bad-quality readings, which remain manual exceptions. Actual noninstrumented fields are produced by technician observation in s1.

S3 retains monitoring/investigation; s4 retains all additional explanation entry and full source/interval/completeness checking. No new data producer is assumed free. If transfer is already native there is zero new transcription saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured. The 35 percent is only actual duplicated transcription, not instrument runtime or primary measurement. Shared observations with 17830 and meter data with 17829 counted once; save retains one percent using existing check.
unknowns: How much actual duplicate transcription remains?
research_questions: Can native fields replace rekeying while preserving missing-data and final-record checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual tag/interval mapping and investigate changed instrument fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final processing record and exact batch/interval destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross actual duplicated transcription 35; minus 1 upkeep = 34. Half eligible gives 17.5 minus 1 = 16.5. Observation, monitoring, complete checks and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect samples and perform routine biofuels quality tests.

steps.what: Collect and identify actual biofuels samples using required sampling method
inputs: actual process material and sample plan
actual sample containers and collection requirements
outputs: actual collected samples and captured sample identities/conditions

steps.what: Perform actual routine laboratory tests and capture measured results and quality-control observations
inputs: actual collected samples and captured sample identities/conditions
actual approved test methods and equipment
outputs: actual measured raw results, units and test quality-control observations

steps.what: Calculate routine result values using approved formulas and assess test validity and quality
inputs: actual measured raw results, units and test quality-control observations
actual approved formulas and quality limits
outputs: checked calculated results and actual quality assessment

steps.what: Complete and check final actual sample, test and quality result record
inputs: checked calculated results and actual quality assessment
actual collected samples and captured sample identities/conditions
actual measured raw results, units and test quality-control observations
outputs: checked final actual test record and sample destination

steps.what: Commit checked final biofuels test result record
inputs: checked final actual test record and sample destination

tasks.design: Configure approved routine formulas in the laboratory module of {OPS_SYSTEM}, using validated {SPREADSHEET} calculations only if native functions are absent. Actual sample collection, tests, primary-result capture and quality interpretation remain, followed by complete record checking and a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine formula arithmetic may be repeated manually after actual tests.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated native formulas can calculate from actual recorded measurements.
tasks.still_hard: Representative sampling, test execution and invalid-result recognition require actual laboratory work.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises contamination, preparation errors or quality-control failures that invalidate a plausible result.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic; sampling and testing remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved routine laboratory calculations can be configured from measured inputs; this does not collect samples, perform physical tests or establish sample validity.

assumptions: Technician produces actual sample identity, collection conditions, raw measurements, units and quality-control observations in retained s1/s2. Method owner provides validated formulas/limits. S3 retains source/unit checking, validity assessment and interpretation; missing inputs stop calculation.

S4 retains new record fields and complete final sample/result checking. No instrument import is assumed here; if actually required, split actual repeated transcription and separately estimate it. No batch release or quality notification is inferred from test recording; actual release/send needs its own final-result gate.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Existing instrument calculation runtime earns zero saving; proposed reduction covers only manual formula arithmetic. Save retains one percent using existing final check.
research_questions: Can native formulas reduce arithmetic after full unit, method and validity checks?

incremental.description: Validate and maintain actual approved laboratory formulas and limits.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final sample/test result record and exact sample destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.50 repeated formula arithmetic = 7.5; minus 1 upkeep = 6.5. Half eligible gives 3.75 minus 1 = 2.75. Physical sampling/tests, primary capture, interpretation, final check and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor and record actual flow meter performance.

steps.what: Inspect actual flow meter operation and capture required field observations and reference checks
inputs: actual meter and process conditions
actual approved reference-check requirements
outputs: actual meter identity and captured field/reference observations

steps.what: Transfer existing flow meter readings and diagnostic status into performance record draft
inputs: actual meter identity and captured field/reference observations
actual historian meter values, units, timestamps and diagnostic flags

steps.what: Assess actual meter performance against reference checks and investigate abnormal measurements
inputs: source-linked actual meter performance draft
actual meter identity and captured field/reference observations
outputs: actual meter performance assessment and unresolved issues

steps.what: Complete and check final flow meter performance record against actual sources
inputs: actual meter performance assessment and unresolved issues
source-linked actual meter performance draft
outputs: checked final actual flow meter performance record

steps.what: Commit checked final flow meter performance record
inputs: checked final actual flow meter performance record
outputs: saved actual flow meter performance record

tasks.design: Configure native historian-to-meter-record fields in {OPS_SYSTEM} before custom integration. Actual inspection and reference measurement remain with the technician, who assesses performance and completes/checks the final record before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing meter readings and diagnostics may be rekeyed into performance records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tag mappings can transfer those existing values with timestamps and quality status.
tasks.still_hard: A flow reading alone cannot establish meter accuracy or identify the physical fault.
tasks.human_edge: The technician distinguishes actual flow changes from meter degradation using real reference evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less meter-data rekeying; performance judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing meter readings and diagnostic fields can be transferred into records; performance assessment still needs actual reference evidence and inspection.

assumptions: Existing meter/historian produces meter identifier, value, units, timestamp and diagnostic/quality flags. Actual calibration/reference evidence has its real instrument/technician producer; any new reference measurement is fully retained in s1. Missing, stale or unmapped fields remain manual exceptions.

S3 retains investigation and actual performance assessment. S4 retains new findings capture and complete source/meter/interval checking. No calibration change, repair work order or process control action is silently performed; actual action/send needs its own final-version gate.

Shares are provisional, not measured. S2 covers only actual duplicated transcription; existing collection runtime earns zero saving. Shared readings with 17828 counted once. Save retains one percent using existing final checking.
unknowns: Which meter fields are actually rekeyed today?
research_questions: Can native mappings remove transcription while preserving reference and final-record checking?

incremental.description: Maintain actual meter/tag mapping and changed diagnostic-field checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final meter performance record and exact meter/interval destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross actual duplicated meter transcription 20; minus 1 upkeep = 19. Half eligible gives 10 minus 1 = 9. Actual inspection/reference measurement, assessment, complete check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
